endpoint.VerdocsEndpoint.name: VerdocsEndpoint
endpoint.VerdocsEndpoint.summary:
VerdocsEndpoint is a class wrapper for a specific connection and authorization context for calling the Verdocs APIs.
Endpoints can be used for isolated session tasks.

For instance, ephemeral signing sessions may be created independently of a caller's status as an authenticated user.
In that case, an Endpoint can be created and authenticated, used for calls related to signing operations, then
discarded once signing is complete.

Note that endpoint configuration functions return the instance, so they can be chained, e.g.

ungrouped.IDocumentFromData.name: IDocumentFromData
ungrouped.IDocumentFromData.summary:
Represents a document to be attached to a template via a Base64-encoded string attachment. This is the best option
for maximum security but there is a 10MB size limit for the entire creation request. Requests attaching larger files
should use `IDocumentFromUri` or add attachments via `createTemplateDocument` after creating the template.

ungrouped.IDocumentFromUri.name: IDocumentFromUri
ungrouped.IDocumentFromUri.summary:
Represents a document to be attached to a template via an externally-accessible URI. A copy of the document will be
downloaded from the specified URI. Note that the URI will be accessed without headers or other authorization methods
set, so the URI itself must encode any security tokens or keys required to access the file.

ungrouped.IEnvelope.name: IEnvelope
ungrouped.IEnvelope.summary:
An Envelope is a workflow wrapper that shepherds one or more Documents through the various recipients in a signing
process.

ungrouped.IEnvelopeDocument.name: IEnvelopeDocument
ungrouped.IEnvelopeDocument.summary: An EnvelopeDocument is an individual document inside an Envelope package.

ungrouped.IPipelineSettings.name: IPipelineSettings
ungrouped.IPipelineSettings.summary:
Org-level document-pipeline automation flags. Note that these flags are all "opt-in" and default to false if not set.

 - process_acroforms:     Auto-detect AcroForm (fillable PDF) fields when a document has no text tags.
 - process_tags:          Process {{...}} text tags in uploaded documents.
 - ignore_invalid_roles:  Skip (vs. reject) document tags whose role name is empty/invalid.
 - ignore_invalid_fields: Skip (vs. reject) document tags that don't form a valid field.

ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepChallenge.name: IRecipientKbaStepChallenge
ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepChallenge.summary:
If a positive identification was not possible, the user may be asked to answer 1 or more
challenge questions via this response. They should be submitted via `submitKbaChallengeResponse()`.

ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepComplete.name: IRecipientKbaStepComplete
ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepComplete.summary: KBA has been completed and no further action is required.

ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepFailed.name: IRecipientKbaStepFailed
ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepFailed.summary:
Identity verification has failed. The user should be shown the message included. No further
signing operations may be performed.

ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepIdentity.name: IRecipientKbaStepIdentity
ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepIdentity.summary:
A full identity verification is required. Prompt the user for their address and other (optional)
details and submit them via `submitKbaIdentity()`.

ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepNone.name: IRecipientKbaStepNone
ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepNone.summary: KBA is not required at this time.

ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepPin.name: IRecipientKbaStepPin
ungrouped.IRecipientKbaStepPin.summary: A PIN code is required. Prompt the user to enter this PIN, and submit it via `submitKbaPin()`.

ungrouped.IRole.name: IRole
ungrouped.IRole.summary:
A placeholder for an individual recipient, CC, or other party in a signing flow. Roles may be "known" or "unknown."
"Known" roles will have their email address supplied in the template which will get copied to envelopes created from
it. This is used when a certain party will always be the same, e.g. a leasing agent counter-signing a lease.
"Unknown" roles are dynamic, and will be filled in later when the envelope is created.

ungrouped.ISigningSession.name: ISigningSession
ungrouped.ISigningSession.summary: A Signing Session connects a caller to a role within an envelope, and can be used only for calls related to signing that envelope.

ungrouped.ITemplate.name: ITemplate
ungrouped.ITemplate.summary:
A reusable template for creating signable instruments. Templates are used to create Envelopes which contain
Documents to sign.

ungrouped.ITemplateDocument.name: ITemplateDocument
ungrouped.ITemplateDocument.summary: A file attached to the template for display/signing.

ungrouped.IUserSession.name: IUserSession
ungrouped.IUserSession.summary: A User Session connects a caller to a Verdocs profile, and can be used for any operations that profile may perform.

ungrouped.TAccountPermissionAdminAdd.name: TAccountPermissionAdminAdd
ungrouped.TAccountPermissionAdminAdd.summary: Grant the "admin" role to other organization members.

ungrouped.TAccountPermissionAdminRemove.name: TAccountPermissionAdminRemove
ungrouped.TAccountPermissionAdminRemove.summary: Remove the "admin" role from other organization members.

ungrouped.TAccountPermissionMemberAdd.name: TAccountPermissionMemberAdd
ungrouped.TAccountPermissionMemberAdd.summary: Grant the "member" role to other organization members.

ungrouped.TAccountPermissionMemberRemove.name: TAccountPermissionMemberRemove
ungrouped.TAccountPermissionMemberRemove.summary: Remove the "member" role from other organization members.

ungrouped.TAccountPermissionMemberView.name: TAccountPermissionMemberView
ungrouped.TAccountPermissionMemberView.summary: View the members of an organization.

ungrouped.TAccountPermissionOwnerAdd.name: TAccountPermissionOwnerAdd
ungrouped.TAccountPermissionOwnerAdd.summary: Grant the "owner" role to other organization members.

ungrouped.TAccountPermissionOwnerRemove.name: TAccountPermissionOwnerRemove
ungrouped.TAccountPermissionOwnerRemove.summary: Remove the "owner" role from other organization members.

ungrouped.TActiveSession.name: TActiveSession
ungrouped.TActiveSession.summary: An active authenticated session within Verdocs, either for signing or regular user-based operations.

ungrouped.TEnvelopePermissionCancel.name: TEnvelopePermissionCancel
ungrouped.TEnvelopePermissionCancel.summary:
Cancel envelopes. This is a default permission for most users, but it may be removed for
highly regulated environments where envelope activities must be audited, and should not
be canceled.

ungrouped.TEnvelopePermissionOrg.name: TEnvelopePermissionOrg
ungrouped.TEnvelopePermissionOrg.summary:
View envelopes created by other members of the same organization. By default, only templates
having sharing settings controlled by their creators. Envelopes are usually private to the
callers who created them. In some organizations it may be useful to have users who can see
"all activity" by all organization members. This is particularly useful when applied to API
keys to develop applications that can access all data across the organization.

ungrouped.TEnvelopePermissionView.name: TEnvelopePermissionView
ungrouped.TEnvelopePermissionView.summary:
View envelopes. This is a default permission for most users, but it may be removed for
highly regulated environments where once sent, envelopes may only be viewed by specific
users.

ungrouped.TOrgPermissionTransfer.name: TOrgPermissionTransfer
ungrouped.TOrgPermissionTransfer.summary:
Transfer ownership of the organization. This primarily allows the holder to remove his/her own
Owner role or add new Owners even if the holder is not one themselves. This is primarily intended
to be used for reseller scenarios.

ungrouped.TPermission.name: TPermission
ungrouped.TPermission.summary: Operation within Verdocs that users may perform.

ungrouped.TRecipientAuthMethod.name: TRecipientAuthMethod
ungrouped.TRecipientAuthMethod.summary:
The authentication method(s) required for a recipient to access an envelope. "Passcode" will require a
PIN or passcode to be entered, which is intended to be known to the sender and recipient ahead of time
and communicated by means of their choosing. "SMS" and "Email" will send a one-time-code via the respective
channel for the recipient to enter. "KBA" will require the recipient to confirm personal information such
as prior addresses, phone numbers, etc. "ID" will require the recipient to perform full ID-based verification.

ungrouped.TSession.name: TSession
ungrouped.TSession.summary: Represents a possibly-authenticated session within Verdocs, either for signing or regular user-based operations.

ungrouped.TSessionType.name: TSessionType
ungrouped.TSessionType.summary:
Verdocs supports two types of authenticated sessions: User and Signing. Both behave similarly and have similar
properties, but signing sessions only have access to a small set of signing-related functions.

ungrouped.TSortTemplateBy.name: TSortTemplateBy
ungrouped.TSortTemplateBy.summary: Plans provide access to Verdocs product features.

ungrouped.TTemplateMemberDelete.name: TTemplateMemberDelete
ungrouped.TTemplateMemberDelete.summary:
Edit templates shared by other members of the same organization. Those templates must also
have `is_personal` set to false to be editable.

ungrouped.TTemplateMemberRead.name: TTemplateMemberRead
ungrouped.TTemplateMemberRead.summary:
View templates shared by other members of the same organization. Those templates must also
have `is_personal` set to false to be visible.

ungrouped.TTemplateMemberVisibility.name: TTemplateMemberVisibility
ungrouped.TTemplateMemberVisibility.summary:
Edit templates shared by other members of the same organization. Those templates must also
have `is_personal` set to false to be editable.

ungrouped.TTemplateMemberWrite.name: TTemplateMemberWrite
ungrouped.TTemplateMemberWrite.summary:
Edit templates shared by other members of the same organization. Those templates must also
have `is_personal` set to false to be editable.

ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionCreateOrg.name: TTemplatePermissionCreateOrg
ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionCreateOrg.summary: Create templates shared with other users of the same organization.

ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionCreatePerso.name: TTemplatePermissionCreatePersonal
ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionCreatePerso.summary: Create templates private to the creator.

ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionCreatePubli.name: TTemplatePermissionCreatePublic
ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionCreatePubli.summary:
Create public templates. Public templates are still owned and managed by the creator,
but may be searched for and used to create envelopes by other users.

ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionDelete.name: TTemplatePermissionDelete
ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionDelete.summary: Create templates private to the creator.

ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionVisibility.name: TTemplatePermissionVisibility
ungrouped.TTemplatePermissionVisibility.summary: Alter the visiiblity settings on a template.

kba.TRecipientKbaStep.name: TRecipientKbaStep
kba.TRecipientKbaStep.summary:
The recipient's current step in the KBA (Knowledge-Based Authentication) flow. Branch on `kba_step`:
`pin` prompts for a PIN and calls submitKbaPin(), `identity` collects address details for
submitKbaIdentity(), and `challenge` presents questions for submitKbaChallengeResponse().

kba.getKbaStep.name: getKbaStep
kba.getKbaStep.signature: getKbaStep(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelope_id: string, role_name: string): Promise<IRecipientKbaStepNone | IRecipientKbaStepComplete | IRecipientKbaStepPin | IRecipientKbaStepIdentity | IRecipientKbaStepChallenge | IRecipientKbaStepFailed>
kba.getKbaStep.summary:
Get the current KBA status. Note that this may only be called by the recipient and requires a
valid signing session to proceed. Although the Recipient object itself contains indications of
whether KBA is required, it will not contain the current status of the process. If
`recipient.auth_methods` is set (not empty), and `recipient.kba_completed` is false, this endpoint
should be called to determine the next KBA step required.

returns.type: Promise<IRecipientKbaStepNone | IRecipientKbaStepComplete | IRecipientKbaStepPin | IRecipientKbaStepIdentity | IRecipientKbaStepChallenge | IRecipientKbaStepFailed>

kba.submitKbaChallengeResponse.name: submitKbaChallengeResponse
kba.submitKbaChallengeResponse.signature: submitKbaChallengeResponse(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelope_id: string, role_name: string, responses: IKbaChallengeResponse[]): Promise<IRecipientKbaStepNone | IRecipientKbaStepComplete | IRecipientKbaStepPin | IRecipientKbaStepIdentity | IRecipientKbaStepChallenge | IRecipientKbaStepFailed>
kba.submitKbaChallengeResponse.summary:
Submit an identity response to a KBA challenge. Answers should be submitted in the same order as
the challenges were listed in `IRecipientKbaStepChallenge.questions`.

returns.type: Promise<IRecipientKbaStepNone | IRecipientKbaStepComplete | IRecipientKbaStepPin | IRecipientKbaStepIdentity | IRecipientKbaStepChallenge | IRecipientKbaStepFailed>

kba.submitKbaIdentity.name: submitKbaIdentity
kba.submitKbaIdentity.signature: submitKbaIdentity(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelope_id: string, role_name: string, identity: IKbaIdentity): Promise<IRecipientKbaStepNone | IRecipientKbaStepComplete | IRecipientKbaStepPin | IRecipientKbaStepIdentity | IRecipientKbaStepChallenge | IRecipientKbaStepFailed>
kba.submitKbaIdentity.summary: Submit an identity response to a KBA challenge.

returns.type: Promise<IRecipientKbaStepNone | IRecipientKbaStepComplete | IRecipientKbaStepPin | IRecipientKbaStepIdentity | IRecipientKbaStepChallenge | IRecipientKbaStepFailed>

kba.submitKbaPin.name: submitKbaPin
kba.submitKbaPin.signature: submitKbaPin(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelope_id: string, role_name: string, pin: string): Promise<IRecipientKbaStepNone | IRecipientKbaStepComplete | IRecipientKbaStepPin | IRecipientKbaStepIdentity | IRecipientKbaStepChallenge | IRecipientKbaStepFailed>
kba.submitKbaPin.summary: Submit a response to a KBA PIN challenge.

returns.type: Promise<IRecipientKbaStepNone | IRecipientKbaStepComplete | IRecipientKbaStepPin | IRecipientKbaStepIdentity | IRecipientKbaStepChallenge | IRecipientKbaStepFailed>

permissions.TRole.name: TRole
permissions.TRole.summary:
Roles provide access to groups of permissions. Note that for historical reasons there is some overlap in the
use of the term "role". TRole refers to a user type. A "Role" (IRole) is a Template participant placeholder.

permission.userHasPermissions.name: userHasPermissions
permission.userHasPermissions.signature: userHasPermissions(profile: undefined | null | IProfile, permissions: TPermission[]): boolean
permission.userHasPermissions.summary:
Confirm whether the user has all of the specified permissions, resolving the profile's direct
permissions, the permissions granted by its roles, and any group profiles.

invitation.acceptOrganizationInvitation.name: acceptOrganizationInvitation
invitation.acceptOrganizationInvitation.summary:
Accept an invitation. This will automatically create a user record for the caller as well as a profile
with the appropriate role as specified in the invite. The profile will be set as "current" for the caller,
and session tokens will be returned to access the new profile. The profile's email_verified flag will
also be set to true.

invitation.createOrganizationInvitation.name: createOrganizationInvitation
invitation.createOrganizationInvitation.summary: Invite a new user to join the organization.

invitation.declineOrganizationInvitation.name: declineOrganizationInvitation
invitation.declineOrganizationInvitation.signature: declineOrganizationInvitation(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, email: string, token: string): Promise<object>
invitation.declineOrganizationInvitation.summary:
Decline an invitation. This will mark the status "declined," providing a visual indication to the
organization's admins that the invite was declined, preventing further invites from being created
to the same email address, and also preventing the invitee from receiving reminders to join.

invitation.deleteOrganizationInvitation.name: deleteOrganizationInvitation
invitation.deleteOrganizationInvitation.summary:
Delete an invitation. Note that no cancellation message will be sent. Invitations are also one-time-use.
If the invitee attempts to join after the invitation is deleted, accepted, or decline, they will be
shown an error.

invitation.getOrganizationInvitation.name: getOrganizationInvitation
invitation.getOrganizationInvitation.signature: getOrganizationInvitation(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, email: string, token: string): Promise<IOrganizationInvitation>
invitation.getOrganizationInvitation.summary:
Get an invitation's details. This is generally used as the first step of accepting the invite.
A successful response will indicate that the invite token is still valid, and include some
metadata for the organization to style the acceptance screen.

invitation.getOrganizationInvitations.name: getOrganizationInvitations
invitation.getOrganizationInvitations.summary: Get a list of invitations pending for the caller's organization. The caller must be an admin or owner.

invitation.resendOrganizationInvitation.name: resendOrganizationInvitation
invitation.resendOrganizationInvitation.summary: Send a reminder to the invitee to join the organization.

invitation.updateOrganizationInvitation.name: updateOrganizationInvitation
invitation.updateOrganizationInvitation.signature: updateOrganizationInvitation(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, email: string, params: Pick<ICreateInvitationRequest, 'first_name' | 'last_name' | 'role'>): Promise<IOrganizationInvitation>
invitation.updateOrganizationInvitation.summary:
Update an invitation. Note that email may not be changed after the invite is sent. To change
an invitee's email, delete the incorrect entry and create one with the correct value.

brand.addBrandEmailDomain.name: addBrandEmailDomain
brand.addBrandEmailDomain.signature: addBrandEmailDomain(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, brandId: string, params: IAddBrandEmailDomainRequest): Promise<IBrand>
brand.addBrandEmailDomain.summary: Add a custom email domain to a brand.

brand.createBrand.name: createBrand
brand.createBrand.signature: createBrand(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, params: ICreateBrandRequest): Promise<IBrand>

brand.deleteBrand.name: deleteBrand
brand.deleteBrand.signature: deleteBrand(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, brandId: string): Promise<any>
brand.deleteBrand.summary: Delete a brand. Cannot delete the org's default brand.

brand.getBrand.name: getBrand
brand.getBrand.signature: getBrand(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, brandId: string): Promise<IBrand>

brand.getBrands.name: getBrands
brand.getBrands.summary: Get all brands for an organization.

examples.code:
import {getBrands} from '@verdocs/js-sdk';

const brands = await getBrands(endpoint, organizationId);

brand.removeBrandEmailDomain.name: removeBrandEmailDomain
brand.removeBrandEmailDomain.signature: removeBrandEmailDomain(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, brandId: string): Promise<IBrand>
brand.removeBrandEmailDomain.summary: Remove a custom email domain from a brand.

brand.updateBrand.name: updateBrand
brand.updateBrand.signature: updateBrand(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, brandId: string, params: IUpdateBrandRequest): Promise<IBrand>

brand.updateBrandLogo.name: updateBrandLogo
brand.updateBrandLogo.signature: updateBrandLogo(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, brandId: string, file: File, onUploadProgress?: object): Promise<IBrand>
brand.updateBrandLogo.summary: Update a brand's logo. Uploads the file and sets `full_logo_url`.

brand.updateBrandThumbnail.name: updateBrandThumbnail
brand.updateBrandThumbnail.signature: updateBrandThumbnail(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, brandId: string, file: File, onUploadProgress?: object): Promise<IBrand>
brand.updateBrandThumbnail.summary: Update a brand's thumbnail. Uploads the file and sets `thumbnail_url`.

brand.verifyBrandEmailDomain.name: verifyBrandEmailDomain
brand.verifyBrandEmailDomain.signature: verifyBrandEmailDomain(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, organizationId: string, brandId: string): Promise<IBrand>
brand.verifyBrandEmailDomain.summary: Trigger verification of a brand's email domain (checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

group.addGroupMember.name: addGroupMember
group.addGroupMember.signature: addGroupMember(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, groupId: string, profile_id: string): Promise<any>
group.addGroupMember.summary: Add a member to a group.

examples.code:
import {addGroupMember} from '@verdocs/js-sdk';

await addGroupMember(VerdocsEndpoint.getDefault(), 'GROUPID', 'PROFILEID');

group.createGroup.name: createGroup
group.createGroup.summary: Create a group. Note that "everyone" is a reserved name and may not be created.

examples.code:
import {createGroup} from '@verdocs/js-sdk';

const group = await createGroup(VerdocsEndpoint.getDefault(), {name:'newgroup'});

group.deleteGroup.name: deleteGroup
group.deleteGroup.summary: Get an organization by ID. Note that the "everyone" group cannot be deleted.

examples.code:
import {deleteGroup} from '@verdocs/js-sdk';

await deleteGroup(VerdocsEndpoint.getDefault(), 'ORGID');

group.deleteGroupMember.name: deleteGroupMember
group.deleteGroupMember.signature: deleteGroupMember(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, groupId: string, profile_id: string): Promise<any>
group.deleteGroupMember.summary: Remove a member from a group.

examples.code:
import {deleteGroupMember} from '@verdocs/js-sdk';

await deleteGroupMember(VerdocsEndpoint.getDefault(), 'GROUPID', 'PROFILEID');

group.getGroup.name: getGroup
group.getGroup.summary: Get the details for a group, including its member profiles and list of permissions.

examples.code:
import {getGroup} from '@verdocs/js-sdk/v2/organization-groups';

const group = await getGroup(GROUPID);

group.getGroups.name: getGroups
group.getGroups.summary:
Get a list of groups for the caller's organization. NOTE: Any organization member may request
the list of groups, but only Owners and Admins may update them.

examples.code:
import {getGroups} from '@verdocs/js-sdk';

const groups = await getGroups();

group.updateGroup.name: updateGroup
group.updateGroup.signature: updateGroup(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, groupId: string, params: object): Promise<any>
group.updateGroup.summary: Update a group. Note that "everyone" is a reserved name and may not be changed.

examples.code:
import {updateGroup} from '@verdocs/js-sdk';

const updated = await updateGroup(VerdocsEndpoint.getDefault(), {name:'newname'});

recipient.askQuestion.name: askQuestion
recipient.askQuestion.signature: askQuestion(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelopeId: string, roleName: string, params: object): Promise<IRecipient>
recipient.askQuestion.summary:
Ask the sender a question. This will email the envelope's sender (via sender_email, if set when
the envelope was created) with the recipient's information and their question. It is up to the
sender to determine how to reply.

recipient.delegateRecipient.name: delegateRecipient
recipient.delegateRecipient.signature: delegateRecipient(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelopeId: string, roleName: string, params: object): Promise<object>
recipient.delegateRecipient.summary:
Delegate a recipient's signing responsibility. The envelope sender must enable this before the
recipient calls this endpoint, and only the recipient may call it, or the call will be rejected.
The recipient's role will be renamed and configured to indicate to whom the delegation was made,
and a new recipient entry with the updated details (e.g. name and email address) will be added
to the flow with the same role_name, order, and sequence of the original recipient. Unless
no_contact is set on the envelope, the delegation recipient and envelope creator will also be
notified.

recipient.envelopeRecipientAgree.name: envelopeRecipientAgree
recipient.envelopeRecipientAgree.signature: envelopeRecipientAgree(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelopeId: string, roleName: string, disclosures?: string, data?: IRecipientDisclosureAgreeBody): Promise<IRecipient>

recipient.envelopeRecipientDecline.name: envelopeRecipientDecline
recipient.envelopeRecipientDecline.signature: envelopeRecipientDecline(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelopeId: string, roleName: string): Promise<IRecipient>
recipient.envelopeRecipientDecline.summary:
Decline electronic signing dislosures. Note that if any recipient declines, the entire envelope
becomes non-viable and later recipients may no longer act. The creator will receive a notification
when this occurs.

recipient.envelopeRecipientSubmit.name: envelopeRecipientSubmit
recipient.envelopeRecipientSubmit.signature: envelopeRecipientSubmit(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelopeId: string, roleName: string, data?: IRecipientSubmitBody): Promise<IRecipient>
recipient.envelopeRecipientSubmit.summary: Submit an envelope (signing is finished). Note that all fields must be valid/completed for this to succeed.

recipient.getInPersonLink.name: getInPersonLink
recipient.getInPersonLink.signature: getInPersonLink(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelope_id: string, role_name: string): Promise<IInPersonLinkResponse>
recipient.getInPersonLink.summary:
Get an in-person signing link. Must be called by the owner/creator of the envelope. The response
also includes the raw access key that may be used to directly initiate a signing session (see
`startSigningSession`) as well as an access token representing a valid signing session for
immediate use in embeds or other applications. Note that in-person signing is considered a
lower-security operation than authenticated signing, and the final envelope certificate will
reflect this.

recipient.remindRecipient.name: remindRecipient
recipient.remindRecipient.signature: remindRecipient(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelopeId: string, roleName: string): Promise<object>
recipient.remindRecipient.summary:
Send a reminder to a recipient. The recipient must still be an active member of the signing flow
(e.g. not declined, already submitted, etc.)

recipient.resetRecipient.name: resetRecipient
recipient.resetRecipient.signature: resetRecipient(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelopeId: string, roleName: string): Promise<object>
recipient.resetRecipient.summary:
Fully reset a recipient. This allows the recipient to restart failed KBA flows, change
fields they may have filled in incorrectly while signing, etc. This cannot be used on a
canceled or completed envelope, but may be used to restart an envelope marked declined.

recipient.startSigningSession.name: startSigningSession
recipient.startSigningSession.signature: startSigningSession(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelope_id: string, role_name: string, key: string): Promise<ISignerTokenResponse>
recipient.startSigningSession.summary:
Begin a signing session for an Envelope. This path requires an invite code, and should generally
be called with a NON-default Endpoint to avoid conflicting with any active user session the user
may have. To initiate in-person signing by an authenticated user (e.g. self-signing), call
getInPersonLink() instead. The response from that call includes both a link for direct signing
via a Web browser as well as an in-person access_key. That access_key.key may be used here as well.

recipient.updateRecipient.name: updateRecipient
recipient.updateRecipient.signature: updateRecipient(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, envelopeId: string, roleName: string, params: IUpdateRecipientParams): Promise<IRecipient>
recipient.updateRecipient.summary:
Update a recipient. NOTE: User interfaces should rate-limit this operation to avoid spamming recipients.
Excessive use of this endpoint may result in Verdocs rate-limiting the calling application to prevent
abuse. This endpoint will return a 200 OK even if the no_contact flag is set on the envelope (in which
case the call will be silently ignored).

recipient.verifySigner.name: verifySigner
recipient.verifySigner.summary:
Verify a recipient within a signing session. All signing sessions use an invite code at a minimum,
but many scenarios require more robust verification of recipients, so one or more verification
methods may be attached to each recipient. If an authentication method is enabled, the
signer must first accept the e-signature disclosures, then complete each verification step
before attempting to view/display documents, complete any fields, or submit the envelope.
This endpoint should be called to complete each step. If the call fails an error will be
thrown.

token.AtoB.name: AtoB
token.AtoB.summary:
Simplified, Node/Browser-safe alternative to atob() for base64 decoding.
Modified from https://github.com/MaxArt2501/base64-js/blob/master/base64.js

token.decodeAccessTokenBody.name: decodeAccessTokenBody
token.decodeAccessTokenBody.summary:
Decode the body of an Verdocs access token. Note that raw tokens contain namespaced fields, e.g.
`https://verdocs.com/profile_id`. To make these tokens easier to use in front-end code, this name-spacing
will be removed. Note that user and signing sessions have different access token formats. The calling
application should distinguish between the two based on the context of the authenticated session, or by
the presence of the `document_id` field, which will only be present for signing sessions.

token.decodeJWTBody.name: decodeJWTBody
token.decodeJWTBody.summary:
Decode the body of a JWT. This helper may allow front-end applications to avoid a dependency on `jsonwebtoken` in
many cases. Note that this should only be used for true JWTs. Opaque tokens will cause this to throw.

examples.code:
import {decodeJWTBody} from '@verdocs/js-sdk';

const claims = decodeJWTBody(token);

auth.changePassword.name: changePassword
auth.changePassword.summary: Update the caller's password when the old password is known (typically for logged-in users).

auth.getMyUser.name: getMyUser
auth.getMyUser.summary: Get the caller's current user record.

auth.getOAuth2AuthorizeUrl.name: getOAuth2AuthorizeUrl
auth.getOAuth2AuthorizeUrl.summary:
Build the URL that starts an OAuth2 authorization code flow. Redirect the user's browser to this URL
to begin the flow. After the user authenticates and authorizes, they will be redirected to
`redirect_uri` with a `code` query parameter that can be exchanged for tokens via `authenticate()`

organization.getActiveEntitlements.name: getActiveEntitlements

Largely intended to be used internally by Web SDK components but may be informative for other cases.
Entitlements are feature grants such as "ID-based KBA" that require paid contracts to enable, typically
because the underlying services that support them are fee-based. Entitlements may run concurrently,
and may have different start/end dates e.g. "ID-based KBA" may run 1/1/2026-12/31/2026 while
"SMS Authentication" may be added later and run 6/1/2026-5/31/2027. The entitlements list is a simple
array of enablements and may include entries that are not YET enabled or have now expired.

In client code it is helpful to simply know "is XYZ feature currently enabled?" This function collapses
the entitlements list to a simplified dictionary of current/active entitlements. Note that it is async
because it calls the server to obtain the "most current" entitlements list. Existence of an entry in the
resulting dictionary implies the feature is active. Metadata inside each entry can be used to determine
limits, etc.

profile.createProfile.name: createProfile
profile.createProfile.summary:
Create a new profile. Note that there are two registration paths for creation:
  - Get invited to an organization, by an admin or owner of that org.
  - Created a new organization. The caller will become the first owner of the new org.

This endpoint is for the second path, so an organization name is required. It is NOT
required to be unique because it is very common for businesses to have the same names,
without conflicting (e.g. "Delta" could be Delta Faucet or Delta Airlines).

The new profile will automatically be set as the user's "current" profile, and new
session tokens will be returned to the caller. However, the caller's email may not yet
be verified. In that case, the caller will not yet be able to call other endpoints in
the Verdocs API. The caller will need to check their email for a verification code,
which should be submitted via the `verifyEmail` endpoint.

signature.createSignature.name: createSignature
signature.createSignature.signature: createSignature(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, name: string, signature: Blob): Promise<ISignature>
signature.createSignature.summary:
Create a signature block. In a typical signing workflow, the user is asked at the beginning of the process to
"adopt" a signature block to be used for all signature fields in the document. Thus, this is typically called one
time to create and store a signature block. Thereafter, the ID of the signature block may be re-used for each
signature field to be "stamped" by the user.

Note: Both "guest" signers and authenticated users can create initials blocks. Guest signers
typically only ever have one, tied to that session. But authenticated users can create more than
one, and can use them interchangeably.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentDown.name: getTemplateDocumentDownloadLink
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentDown.signature: getTemplateDocumentDownloadLink(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, _envelopeId: string, documentId: string): Promise<string>
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentDown.summary:
Get an envelope document's metadata, or the document itself. If no "type" parameter is specified,
the document metadata is returned. If "type" is set to "file", the document binary content is
returned with Content-Type set to the MIME type of the file. If "type" is set to "download", a
string download link will be returned. If "type" is set to "preview" a string preview link will
be returned. This link expires quickly, so it should be accessed immediately and never shared.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentFile.name: getTemplateDocumentFile
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentFile.signature: getTemplateDocumentFile(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, templateId: string, documentId: string): Promise<any>
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentFile.summary:
Get (binary download) a file attached to a Template. It is important to use this method
rather than a direct A HREF or similar link to set the authorization headers for the
request.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPage.name: getTemplateDocumentPageDisplayUri
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPage.signature: getTemplateDocumentPageDisplayUri(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, documentId: string, page: number, variant: 'original' | 'tagged' = 'original'): Promise<string>
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPage.summary:
Get a display URI for a given page in a file attached to a template document. These pages are rendered server-side
into PNG resources suitable for display in IMG tags although they may be used elsewhere. Note that these are intended
for DISPLAY ONLY, are not legally binding documents, and do not contain any encoded metadata from participants. The
original asset may be obtained by calling `getTemplateDocumentFile()` or similar.

templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPrev.signature: getTemplateDocumentPreviewLink(endpoint: VerdocsEndpoint, _envelopeId: string, documentId: string): Promise<string>
templateDocument.getTemplateDocumentPrev.summary:
Get a pre-signed preview link for an Envelope Document. This link expires quickly, so it should
be accessed immediately and never shared. Content-Disposition will be set to "inline".
